text: Concert pianist Paul Orlac loses his hands in a [horrible railway accident|trigger|a sudden accident or attack], and a surgeon grafts on [the hands of an executed murderer|images|wounded and changing bodies] named Vasseur. Haunted by a knife like Vasseur's and [a growing desire to kill|threat|the enemy within], Orlac can no longer play, and he and his wife Yvonne sink into debt. When his father is found stabbed, a scarred stranger claiming to be Vasseur arrives wanting [money to keep quiet|wants|wealth and ambition].
